/* Built from b9ef12f (FMP1 envelope 5): a pattern-only project image with
 * several used patterns, pattern 3 active and a non-default session, plus what
 * the b9ef12f decoder restores from it; printed as a C header. */
#include "pattern_project.h"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
static uint8_t arena[60000], work_arena[60000], out_arena[60000], encoded[FM1_PROJECT_RECORD_MAX], wire[FM1_PROJECT_MAX];
static uint8_t session[FM1_PROJECT_SESSION], restored[FM1_PROJECT_SESSION], work_session[FM1_PROJECT_SESSION];
static br_pattern_snapshot live, clip, work_pattern, loaded;
static br_pattern_bank bank, out_bank;
static fm1_pattern_song state, out_state;
static fm1_project_work work;
static int valid(const uint8_t *p,size_t n,void *ctx){(void)ctx;return n==FM1_PROJECT_SESSION&&p[0]==0x42;}
static void init_pattern(br_pattern_snapshot *p){memset(p,0,sizeof *p);for(unsigned i=0;i<BR_PARTS;i++){p->length[i]=16;p->division[i]=1;}
 memset(p->synth_note,255,sizeof p->synth_note);memset(p->synth_velocity,255,sizeof p->synth_velocity);memset(p->kit_note,255,sizeof p->kit_note);memset(p->kit_pitch,255,sizeof p->kit_pitch);}
static void hex(const char *name,const uint8_t *p,size_t n){printf("static const uint8_t %s[%zu] = {",name,n);for(size_t i=0;i<n;i++)printf("%s%u",i?(i%40?",":",\n"):"\n",p[i]);printf("};\n");}
int main(void){size_t len=0;
 for(unsigned i=0;i<FM1_PROJECT_SESSION;i++)session[i]=(uint8_t)(i*7u+3u);session[0]=0x42;
 init_pattern(&live);assert(br_pattern_bank_init(&bank,arena,sizeof arena)==BR_BANK_OK);
 for(unsigned i=1;i<6;i++){clip=live;clip.step[0][i]=BR_NOTE_STEP(40u+i,100u);clip.synth_note[0][i]=(uint8_t)(40+i);clip.length[1]=8u+i;assert(br_pattern_bank_paste(&bank,i,&live,&clip,encoded,sizeof encoded)==BR_BANK_OK);}
 assert(br_pattern_bank_select(&bank,3,&live,&clip,encoded,sizeof encoded)==BR_BANK_OK);
 live.step[2][7]=1u;live.kit_velocity[7][0]=90;
 fm1_pattern_song_init(&state);state.used=bank.used;state.active=bank.active;
 work.compressed=encoded;work.compressed_capacity=sizeof encoded;work.session=work_session;work.arena=work_arena;work.arena_capacity=sizeof work_arena;work.pattern=&work_pattern;
 assert(fm1_project_encode(session,&bank,&live,&state,valid,0,&work,wire,sizeof wire,&len)==FM1_PROJECT_OK&&wire[4]==5);
 assert(fm1_project_decode(wire,len,valid,0,&work,restored,&out_bank,out_arena,sizeof out_arena,&loaded,&out_state)==FM1_PROJECT_OK);
 printf("/* Generated by gen_v5_project.c built in b9ef12f (FMP1 envelope 5). */\n");
 printf("#define V5_USED %uu\n#define V5_ACTIVE %uu\n",out_bank.used,out_bank.active);
 printf("static const uint32_t v5_offset[11] = {");for(int i=0;i<11;i++)printf("%s%zuu",i?",":"",out_bank.offset[i]);printf("};\n");
 printf("static const uint32_t v5_length[11] = {");for(int i=0;i<11;i++)printf("%s%zuu",i?",":"",out_bank.length[i]);printf("};\n");
 hex("v5_image",wire,len);hex("v5_arena",out_arena,out_bank.size);hex("v5_live",(const uint8_t *)&loaded,sizeof loaded);
 hex("v5_session",restored,sizeof restored);
 return 0;}
